# Get project — `redmine_get_project`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Show full detail for one project, optionally including its trackers, issue categories, time-entry activities, enabled modules, and issue custom fields — needed before creating issues or time entries in an unfamiliar project.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | integer \| string | **yes** | Project id (number) or identifier slug (string), e.g. 42 or "website" (required). |
| `include` | `trackers` \| `issue_categories` \| `time_entry_activities` \| `enabled_modules` \| `issue_custom_fields`[] | no | Associations to expand: "trackers", "issue_categories", "time_entry_activities", "enabled_modules", "issue_custom_fields". |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_get_project",
  "arguments": {
    "project_id": 42,
    "include": [
      "trackers"
    ]
  }
}
```
